profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer
profile.summary:
I am a full-stack software engineer with an expertise in JavaScript and JavaScript frameworks. My experience includes front-end technologies such as Angular, React, Backbone and back-end technologies including Node, Express, MongoDB and MySQL. I have also worked on mobile applications using React Native.

I am passionate about using software to create applications for business and individuals that help them excel in their everyday operations and activities as well as exploring new frameworks and technologies.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Creating tools that empower people to create a healthier and happier relationship with their pup.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Worked on multiple projects in Vue, Node.js, Typescript, and MySQL.

Managed the inflow of thousands of signals from various APIs and created user interfaces to allow users to interact with and consume mission critical data points.

Maintained code quality utilizing unit and integration tests.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Created tools for lawn care professionals and internal teams to manage lawn care jobs. 

Set up REST API endpoints in Java connected to MySQL to manage and save jobs data while creating and maintaining tests to ensure code quality.

Created user interfaces using React and D3 to display jobs data and allow users to manage jobs. Lead the initiative to create and maintain test suits for multiple React projects, increasing overall code quality.

Worked with Python services to streamline delivery of customer reports.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Worked with Angular front end to build application views and utilized NgRx to manage application state.

Worked with and created microservices written in Node and Go connected to MySQL databases. Created REST API endpoints and routed requests to different services through an API gateway.

Developed applications in Docker containers and deployed them to AWS using Kubernetes for container orchestration.

Collaborated with other engineers, product owners, and stakeholders to plan and create new features of the product, bringing revolutionary new software to the Commercial Loans industry.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Utilized Amazon EC2 instances to deploy Node server and Mongo database. Managed setup and builds of the app in a Linux environment as well as version control with git and Github to collaborate with other developers. 

Developed user experience throughout the app using Angular on the front end and Node on the back end by adding new features and refining existing features that included rebuilding the video upload process, refactoring chat utilizing websockets, payment from customers with the Stripe API, and user project management flow.

Optimized video storage and delivery through transcoding and Adaptive Bitrate streaming by connecting to JWPlayer through their api endpoints from our servers using Node.js and Python for better in-app user viewing.

Improved and expanded email system connected to the Mandrill API to improve customer experience through seamless transactional email flow throughout the app including authentication process and job notifications.

Refined and added new features to the internal administrative area of the application to allow marketing and customer service teams better manage and help users with their needs, improving overall customer experience.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Set up and planned front end architecture for new administrative app using Angular 2+ and the Angular CLI.

Rebuilt legacy application by porting functionality from PHP app to new Angular/Node app, improving efficiency and ease of use across the entire user experience.

Built out new features on video player web app using AngularJS and with team of developers using Git.
Worked hand in hand with the CTO, CEO and sales team to best plan throughout the development process.

positions.title: Owner
positions.description:
E-commerce exercise equipment store and online personal training. 

Designed and built e-commerce website using WordPress and integrated multiple free and paid workout programs as marketing funnels that helped over 1,000 people get on track with their fitness goals. Worked with a manufacturer in China and imported exercise equipment to sell on website. Developed online marketing strategy, generated over 10,000 likes on Facebook for under 1 cent per like in just over a week and produced leads at under 20 cents per click.

positions.title: Freelance Web Developer
positions.description:
Developed websites and landing pages for various clients using HTML5, CSS3 and JavaScript. I also set up company blogs for clients using WordPress as well as eCommerce store fronts and shopping carts using WordPress and WooCommerce. 

Optimized websites using SEO and keyword research techniques to show up on the first page in search results for specific keywords.

positions.title: Online Marketing and Content Manager
positions.description: Managed content generation and paid advertising across multiple review websites. Developed social presence and increased user engagement across these sites. Worked directly with the Chief Marketing Officer to develop and implement online marketing strategies.

positions.title: Email Marketing Manager
positions.description: Managed and cleaned multiple email lists for different clients.

volunteerExperiences.description: Helped individuals overcome addictions and served people in the community on a daily basis.

projects.title: GradeKeep
projects.description:
A web app that gives teachers the ability organize students, classes and scores and administrators to view teacher and student stats

Role: Full Stack Software Engineer
Tech Stack: React, Redux, Node, Express, PostgreSQL

• Utilized relational database tables using Sequelize to store user information, allowing maximum efficiency
• Constructed server side routing and queries using Node and Express to retrieve information from the database
• Developed client side functionality using React and Redux to allow users a variety of sign in options

projects.title: Gym Logger
projects.description:
A web app that allows personal trainers to create and share workouts with their clients

Role: Full Stack Software Engineer (Product Owner)
Tech Stack: Angular, Node, Express, PostgreSQL

• Built out views and nested views using Angular’s UI Router, adding functionality to allow trainers to create, store and view client workouts, and additionally implemented ability for users to view workouts created for them
• Integrated user authentication with OAuth and Facebook to ensure users a secure login
• Engineered RESTful API and server-side routing using Node and Express to pull user data from the database
